svg.text: Current engineering workflow from Jira ticket to production maintenance
Crashlytics, screenshots, recordings, logs, UI refs
• Production monitoring is part of development.
• Every production issue becomes a new Jira task.

This workflow represents Ralph's actual engineering process. It is not the company's complete SDLC. It focuses on the work performed by a developer from receiving a Jira ticket through implementation, release preparation, and production monitoring.
